summary.title: Flutter Wordle Clone Mobile/Web/Desktop Tutorial | Apps From Scratch
summary.one_liner: You learn how to structure and build a Wordle-style word game in Flutter, covering models, board and keyboard widgets, win/loss checks, keyboard state and tile flip animations.
keywords: how to make wordle with flutter
takeaways: Set up a Flutter project and organise its folder structure for a word game
Model letters and words with simple Dart classes to hold game data
Build a game screen with a board of tiles and an on-screen keyboard
Handle keyboard input, detect win or loss, and keep keyboard key colours in sync with guesses
Add a tile flip effect when a guess is submitted
summary.summary: This is a video tutorial from the Apps From Scratch channel by Marcus Ng that walks through building a Wordle clone in Flutter, targeting mobile, web and desktop. The chapters follow a build order: project setup, folder structure, letter and word models, game state on the Wordle screen, the board and board tiles, the keyboard and keyboard buttons, keyboard interactions, win/loss checks, maintaining keyboard state, and flipping tiles. The page text lists chapters and metadata only; the full code walkthrough is in the video and its transcript, which were not included here.
